```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(effsize)
library(ez)
library(patchwork)
library(magick)
library(EnvStats)
library(psychReport)
library(emmeans)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggcorrplot)

windowsFonts(Arial=windowsFont("Arial"))
```

```{r data read, include=FALSE}
participantList <- read.csv("Exp1_Data/Exp1_participantList.csv") 

cbPalette <- viridis(n=2)
```

```{r data processing aprime}
aPrimeData <- read.csv("Exp1_Data/Exp1_aprime.csv")
aPrimeData$Group<- factor(aPrimeData$Group, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Typical Viewers","Super recognizers"))

summaryAPrimeData <- aPrimeData %>%
  gather(key="VisualCondition",value="aprime",X12:X100) %>%
  mutate(VisualCondition = as.integer(gsub('[a-zA-Z]', '',VisualCondition)))

summaryAPrimeData$VisualCondition <- factor(summaryAPrimeData$VisualCondition, levels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"))

summaryAPrimeData$WindowSize <- factor(summaryAPrimeData$VisualCondition, levels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"),labels=c("30","25","20","15","10","5"))
```

```{r aprime, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(data=summaryAPrimeData,aes(x = VisualCondition,y = aprime,fill = Group)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=cbPalette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=cbPalette) +
  geom_violin(alpha=0.2,scale = "width",show.legend = F,position=position_dodge(1),colour="black") +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5,alpha=0.4,fatten=NULL,position=position_dodge(1),show.legend = F,colour='black') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(family = 'Arial', face="bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
              axis.title = element_text(family = 'Arial', face="bold", size = 18),
              axis.text = element_text(family = 'Arial', colour="black", size = 16),
              axis.line.x = element_line('black', size = 1),
              axis.line.y = element_line('black', size = 1),
              axis.ticks = element_line('black', size = 1),
              legend.title = element_text(family = 'Arial', face="bold", size = 16),
              legend.text =  element_text(family = 'Arial', size = 12),
              legend.position = "top",
              legend.key =  element_blank(),
              panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
              strip.text= element_text(family = 'Arial', face='bold', size = 16),
              strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'white')) +
  labs(x="Preserved Face Information (%)",y="A'", colour = "Group",fill = "Group",shape = "Group") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar",show.legend = F,width=0.2,position=position_dodge(1),colour="black")+
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", shape = 23,size=3,position=position_dodge(1),colour="black")+
ggsave("Figures/Exp1_aprimePlot.png",width = 9, height = 6,dpi=150)
```

```{r data processing trialData}
trialData <- read.csv("Exp1_Data/Exp1_Latency_Gini.csv")

trialDataJoiner <- trialData %>% 
  rename(Trial = trial_number) %>% 
  select(ID,Trial,image)

trialData$group<- factor(trialData$group, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Typical Viewers","Super-recognizers"))
trialData$phase<- factor(trialData$phase, levels = c(1,2),labels = c("Face Learning","Face Recognition"))
trialData$visualcondition<- factor(trialData$visualcondition, levels = c("1","6","5","4","3","2"), labels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"))

RecognitionPhaseOnlyData <- trialData %>% 
  filter(phase=="Face Recognition")

RTPlotData <- RecognitionPhaseOnlyData %>% 
  group_by(subject_number,visualcondition,group) %>% 
  summarise(meanRT = mean(timeanswer))

GiniPlotData <- trialData %>% 
  group_by(subject_number,visualcondition,phase,group) %>% 
  summarise(meanGini = mean(Gini))

```

```{r data processing PC1}
pcaData <- read.csv("Exp1_Data/Exp1_pc1_loading.csv")
pcaData$Group<- factor(pcaData$Group, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Typical Viewers","Super recognizers"))
pcaData$Aperture <- factor(pcaData$Aperture,levels = c("30","25","20","15","10","5"), labels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"))

pcaPlotData <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Aperture,Group) %>% 
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1))

pcaPlotData$Phase<- factor(pcaPlotData$Phase, levels = c("Learning","Recognition"),labels = c("Face Learning","Face Recognition"))

pcaPlotData_byAperture_mean <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Aperture,Group) %>% 
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1)) %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Group) %>% 
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(meanPC1)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=Phase,values_from=meanPC1)

pcaPlotData_byAperture_sd <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Aperture,Group) %>% 
  summarise(sdPC1 = sd(PC1)) %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Group) %>% 
  summarise(sdPC1 = mean(sdPC1)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=Phase,values_from=sdPC1)

cor.test(pcaPlotData_byAperture_mean$Learning,pcaPlotData_byAperture_mean$Recognition)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byAperture_sd$Learning,pcaPlotData_byAperture_sd$Recognition)

pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Aperture,Group) %>% 
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=Phase:Aperture,values_from=meanPC1)

cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_100,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_100)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_60,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_60)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_48,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_48)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_36,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_36)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_24,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_24)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_12,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_12)

pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Aperture,Group) %>% 
  summarise(sdPC1 = sd(PC1)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=Phase:Aperture,values_from=sdPC1)

meanPCAData <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(Phase,Group) %>% 
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1))

cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_100,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_100)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_60,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_60)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_48,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_48)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_36,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_36)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_24,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_24)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_12,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_12)
```

```{r data processing Fixation Statistics}
fixationData <- read.csv("Exp1_Data/Exp1_fixationCount_Duration.csv")
trialData <- read.csv("Exp1_Data/Exp1_Latency_Gini.csv")

trialDataJoiner <- trialData %>% 
  rename(Trial = trial_number) %>% 
  select(ID,Trial,image, timeanswer)

fixationData<- inner_join(fixationData,trialDataJoiner,by=c("ID","Trial"))

fixationData$Group<- factor(fixationData$Group, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Typical Viewers","Super-recognizers"))
fixationData$Phase<- factor(fixationData$Phase, levels = c(1,2),labels = c("Face Learning","Face Recognition"))
fixationData$windowsize<- factor(fixationData$VisualCondition, levels = c("1","6","5","4","3","2"), labels = c("30","25","20","15","10","5"))
fixationData$VisualCondition<- factor(fixationData$VisualCondition, levels = c("1","6","5","4","3","2"), labels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"))


trialFixationData <- fixationData %>%
  group_by(ID,Trial,image,Group,Phase,VisualCondition,windowsize,timeanswer) %>% 
  summarise(fixationCount = n(),meanFixationDuration = mean(FixationDuration)*1000,meanGazeDistance=mean(DistanceFromCenter), meanDistanceBetweenFix = mean(DistanceFromLastFix,na.rm=TRUE), sumDistanceBetweenFix = sum(DistanceFromLastFix,na.rm=TRUE))

fixationPlotData<-trialFixationData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Group,Phase,VisualCondition,windowsize) %>% 
  summarise(meanFixationCount = mean(fixationCount),meanFixationDuration = mean(meanFixationDuration),meanGazeDistance=mean(meanGazeDistance),meanDistanceBetweenFix = mean(meanDistanceBetweenFix,na.rm=TRUE),sumDistanceBetweenFix=mean(sumDistanceBetweenFix,na.rm=TRUE)) 

fixationPlotData_long<- fixationPlotData%>% 
  gather(key="DV",value="Value",meanFixationCount:meanDistanceBetweenFix)

fixationPlotData_long$DV<-factor(fixationPlotData_long$DV,levels=c("meanFixationCount","meanFixationDuration","meanGazeDistance","meanDistanceBetweenFix"),labels=c("Count","Duration (ms)", "Center Distance (degrees)","Travelled (degrees)"))
```
